no_laterality_rule.decision_time: before Part B and before any MaleCNS registry output
no_laterality_rule.filter: Every syn-partners row with primary_post == NO remains in the central-complex numerator, so the item-152 CX_DAN keep/drop rule is unchanged.
no_laterality_rule.matrix: Assign each primary_post == NO synapse to NO_L or NO_R from the postsynaptic cell canonical side (somaSide, then rootSide). If side is absent, split that synapse 0.5/0.5. Use the same split when constructing CX_DAN innervation.
no_laterality_rule.reason: The postsynaptic target provides anatomy-based laterality while preserving the established two-sided compartment ontology; an unlabelled target carries no evidence for one side.

outcome_blinding: Classes and the NO rule were frozen before building MaleCNS compartments, matrices, exposures, transmitter rows, dopamine rows, or drive rows. Part B may not reclassify a value after inspecting output.
